newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen weakening further on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen weakening further on Thursday.

text.p: French stocks expected to open weaker on Thursday, extending their losses, on nervousness ahead of the runoff vote on Sunday for the parliamentary election.
"People aren't going to take any risks today and tomorrow," a trader said.
* CAC-40 May futures contract traded on GLOBEX down 12.5 at 2,577.5 at 0730 GMT
* The CAC-40 index closed down 3.6 percent on Wednesday to 2,583.17 in selloff triggered by poll rumours
"Anglo-Saxon investors could keep selling and we could head toward 2,530-2,550 initially and then 2,500 tomorrow," the trader said.
Another broker expects the market to stabilise at current levels, helped by bottom-fishing after two big falls this week.
